tex_content.html: \begin{equation} \Vol B(q_\infty ,0,1)=\frac{\omega _3}{2} \end{equation} and $R(q_\infty ,0)=0$. The strong maximum principle makes the limit flat. It is not $\Ar ^3$ by the volume identity, while every nontrivial complete flat quotient has zero asymptotic volume and is not non-collapsed on all scales, a contradiction. □
